newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end barely up before options expiry.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end barely up before options expiry.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures finished barely higher after a thinly-traded session.
Market sources noted light local and speculative activity, and added that dealings are likely to remain rangebound ahead of Friday's January options expiry.
A lack of fundamental news and a quiet cash market contributed to the marekt's dull tone, they said.
"We are hoping the cash market condition picks up as harvest gains momentum," Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter, said.
The approaching Dec 15 start of the cold season could also prompt interest, she said.
The January contract closed up 0.05 to 96.35, traded 96.70 to 96.05. The back months finished 0.45 and 0.40 firmer.
Near-term support basis January was pegged at 95.00 cents and then at 91.75 cents. Resistance was seen at 100.58 cents, the 40-day moving average.
